Sections.Title: Medical Therapy for Relief of Angina
Sections.Content: Various medical therapies for angina relief are compared such as beta-blockers, calcium antagonists, and ranolazine. Comparisons and studies on efficiency and safety of different drugs in patients with stable angina are provided.

Sections.Title: Management of Refractory Angina
Sections.Content: Discusses the management of refractory angina, highlighting various trials and studies focused on patients with this condition.

Sections.Title: Chelation Therapy
Sections.Content: Reviews studies and trials regarding the efficacy and safety of chelation therapy, including specific trials like the Trial to Assess Chelation Therapy (TACT) which assessed chelation therapy in patients with coronary artery disease.
